text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Tch. First place slipped right through my fingers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The calculations got screwed up somewhere.
I gotta crush this bug fast...
choice_data_list: I'd say that was a great run.
Once we fix what's holding us back, we can move forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Cut the soft crap.
Calculation results beyond expectations are entirely meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Well, it's true some parts went well. I'm not gonna overlook that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's head back.
I wanna get right to rewriting this code.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Easy for you to say.
I'd recommend you try experiencing some debugging yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Fine, then. As a test, try making a full list of all the challenges you can think of and submit it to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you can point out a problem I haven't noticed,
I'll give you some praise.
